No block encountered at either tier; tier (c) Claude-in-Chrome not needed. QTY: each page's rendered 'N Products' header text, cross-checked against the embedded Algolia nbHits field in the same fetch - matched on every page. Poufs & Cubes, Planters, Wall Decor & Wallpaper, Lighting, Mirrors (Decor mega-menu siblings) - out of Textile/Storage scope. /pet-beds/ - pet product, excluded. All product-detail, search, and View-All URLs excluded per URL rule.
